title: AEGIS Rulebook v2 — NEW RULEBOOK (template v2)
description: Trade logic from AEGIS-NEW-RULEBOOK: #2/#1 crosses, #5 divergence, #8/#7 price filter, #4 final filter. #3 Williams and #6 RSI are template-only (not execution drivers).
changelog: v2: Replace v1 base rules with NEW RULEBOOK semantics

roles.#2: Motional green Bands17 — cross detector vs #1
roles.#3: Williams %R60 brown — template only, not execution
roles.#6: RSI9 cyan — template only, not execution
roles.#8: Main BB20 cyan/cobalt (price panel) — direction vs #7

rules_summary: SELL (uptrend / price higher-high): any #2 band crosses above any #1 band; #5 makes higher-low (bearish div); #8U above #7U; #4 higher-low within #7 bands; block if #8L still above #7M without recross
BUY (downtrend / price lower-low): mirror — #2 below #1; #5 lower-high; #8L below #7L; #4 lower-high within #7; block if #8U still below #7M without recross
